name: PromptedSite
description:
PromptedSite Design Assistant connects Claude to your PromptedSite account so
you can find a design direction and get the prompt that builds it.

Search the catalog by natural-language product, industry, visual-style, or
frontend technology terms. Inspect a template's category, tier, asset type,
technology stack, and preview link. Compare two to five templates side by side.

After you sign in with your PromptedSite account and approve the connector,
Claude can also check what your account currently has access to, and retrieve
full prompt text. Free prompts are available to any signed-in account; premium
prompts are returned only while your PromptedSite access is active. Entitlement
is evaluated against PromptedSite's purchase records on every call, so a new
purchase, an expiry, or a refund takes effect immediately with no need to
reconnect.

Every tool is read-only. The connector cannot create an account, start checkout,
move money, modify site data, or download source archives. It never returns
passwords, email addresses, payment details, order identifiers, or source keys.

You need a PromptedSite account to connect. Creating one is free, and it is
enough to browse the catalog and use free prompts; premium prompt text requires
an active PromptedSite plan.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PromptedSite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PromptedSite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://promptedsite.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PromptedSite MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PromptedSite provides these MCP tools: compare_design_templates, get_design_template, search_design_templates, get_promptedsite_access, and get_design_prompt.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PromptedSite?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PromptedSite in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
PromptedSite requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PromptedSite is developed by PromptedSite. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
